resolution.note: Measured 20 runs: median 162 s push/PR to Check (PR 159, push 165) vs t3code PR median 226 s, so target met without Blacksmith. PR #262: duration-weighted shards + 8 shards + parallel bubblewrap; first PR run 115 s with shard spread 61-89 s (was 62-152 s). Faster runners, Go toolchain cache and Changes setup-node removal rejected as not worth it. Baseline in .krn/runs/lead/weakness-hunt/ci-baseline.md.

title: Make Actions CI faster than t3code: runners, toolchain cache, shard rebalance
body:
Operator grant (2026-11-06, verbatim): "wszystkie triki od theo są dozwolone szefie, to musi być superior tool". Split from t-nwdj5hx, which delivered the verification-only Check (isolation/Go by change detection, rules + task check in preflight).
Baseline: KRN Actions CI median PR 451 s / main push 475 s; t3code PR median 226 s. Recon: .krn/runs/lead/ci-actions/t3code-recon.md.
Do (measure each, keep only what cuts push->Check wall-clock or flakes):
1. Faster runners (Blacksmith 4/8 vCPU as t3code) — needs the Blacksmith GitHub App installed on krn-works: operator action, ask once with a ready link.
2. Cache the toolchain (node/pnpm/mise pnpm install, Go with cache: true) instead of mise install per shard.
3. Rebalance shards (3-4 vs 6-8, slowest shard 129 s) by recorded durations (#244 / t-3trwjr9 planner).
4. Sparse checkout + fetch-depth 2 in Changes.
5. Later: test-task cache with verify-hits.
Proof: median push->Check over >=10 PR runs before/after in .krn/runs/lead/ci-actions/speed.md; target <= t3code median.
